title: Misty Breakwater: City Stewardship

foundation.history: A forgotten historic sea wall once protected fog horns, until recurring low-visibility tides forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Rika Kiri, a planner, must repair shared urban infrastructure, relying on district budgeting despite low-visibility tides.
central_conflict: an exclusionary syndicate threatens the historic sea wall by restricting fog horns.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: low-visibility tides destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: an exclusionary syndicate contests access to fog horns
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The historic sea wall becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
